requirement.source: from code, unconfirmed: scripts/update_releases.py and the «Свежие релизы» block (PR #1); schedule changed from weekly to daily by the agent on 2026-11-18 after the block lagged four releases behind
requirement.says: The «Свежие релизы» block shows the latest GitHub release of each flagship (ru-marketplace-mcp, humanizer-ru): tag with a link and the date in Russian, refreshed every day.
requirement.invariant: The block holds exactly one line per flagship in REPOS order, each with that repo's own returned tag, release URL and publication date in Russian («1 марта 2026»); a new release of one repo changes only its line; every byte outside the block stays as it was.
A run against live GitHub prints «[M-RELEASES][BLOCK_WRITE] updated|unchanged:» with the tags that /releases/latest returns at that moment.
The workflow «Свежие релизы» is scheduled daily (06:17 UTC); a successful run commits only README.md, and only when the block changed.

requirement.source: from code, unconfirmed: «keep the old block rather than publish an empty one» in update_releases.py; widened by the agent on 2026-11-18 after the GPT-6.2 Astra review found that one failed lookup silently dropped that project from the block
requirement.says: A failed or odd lookup never publishes a partial or empty block: README.md stays byte-for-byte as it was and the run fails visibly.
requirement.invariant: If the lookup of any one flagship fails (gh error, bad JSON) or any one of tag_name, html_url, published_at is missing, null, blank, multiline, not a date, or the URL is not a release of that repo, main() returns 1 and README.md is unchanged.
Unless README.md has exactly one START marker ending its line and exactly one END marker after it, main() returns 1 and writes nothing (missing, doubled, nested start, extra end, reversed).
Every gh call carries timeout=60; a timeout counts as a failed lookup.

requirement.source: from code, unconfirmed: PR #2 «Профиль под телефон: крупный баннер, проекты без таблицы»; user 2026-11-18: «поработай над ним вместе с gpt 6.2 astra»
requirement.says: The profile reads well on a phone: projects come first, the banner text stays legible at phone width, every number and claim matches the project repositories on the day it was written.
